description: This file contains utility functions for processing flow data, specifically detecting and replacing base64-encoded files within a flow configuration, and managing storage for these files.

methods.name: containsBase64File
methods.description: Checks if the given ChatFlow contains any base64-encoded files in its flow data.

methods.name: updateFlowDataWithFilePaths
methods.description: Updates flow data by replacing base64-encoded files with storage paths, managing storage usage accordingly.
